calibration_exposure.status: calibration-visible physical model-form freeze; chronological heldout outcome firewall remains closed

scientific_hypothesis.dominant_missing_term: one stable machine-specific positive-ion wafer-transmission fingerprint

discovery_record.warning: output-space proxies establish topology and capacity only; they are not physical boundary fits

wafer_boundary_operator.coordinate_frame: official calibration CSV x-y coordinates with rho=hypot(x,y)/0.1 and phi=atan2(y,x)
wafer_boundary_operator.basis: complete real Zernike basis on the unit disk excluding piston
wafer_boundary_operator.normalization_quadrature: deterministic cylindrical finite-volume wafer cells weighted by baseline positive-ion current density
wafer_boundary_operator.physical_action: multiply positive-ion point flux by T before the unchanged surface recurrence
unchanged_channels: La Magna/Garozzo oxide and film surface law

parameter_domain.tool_transfer_scope: same SPTS tool, wafer coordinate frame, electrode/focus-ring configuration, and measurement convention

wall_model_separation.full_calibration: hold the already identified full-calibration v7 wall coefficients fixed while fitting v8 map coefficients
wall_model_separation.whole_lot_fold: refit v7 coefficients using only training lots, freeze them, then fit only v8 map coefficients using the same training lots

candidate_selection.rule: choose the lowest total coefficient count passing every gate
candidate_selection.tie_break: lower static order, then omit the dynamic field
candidate_selection.no_passing_candidate_action: fail v8 and keep heldout sealed
candidate_selection.selection_exposure_warning: all-calibration capacity and a 131-feature ranking were examined before freeze; C4F8 platen Vpp RMS is now the only allowed dynamic feature

identifiability_and_stability_gates.failure_action: refuse prediction seal and do not open heldout outcomes

deterministic_acceleration.surface_table_shape: wall node x local-ion node x wafer x 89 points
deterministic_acceleration.point_independence_basis: unchanged local surface recurrences have no lateral coupling once the reactor boundary is supplied

forbidden_shortcuts: additive or multiplicative corrections applied directly to predicted depth
changing Belen or La Magna/Garozzo surface coefficients
changing total positive-ion current or positive-ion energy
normalizing only over the 89 outcome measurement points
per-lot, per-wafer, per-point, or heldout-specific map coefficients
using wafer number, experiment key, lot number, date, or outcome as a map input
substituting another machine feature after v8 scoring
opening heldout outcomes from output-space proxy performance
weakening absolute, baseline, identifiability, stability, interpolation, replay, or refinement gates

literature_topology_support.citation: Babaeva and Kushner, J. Phys. D 41 062004 (2008)
literature_topology_support.use: focus-ring gap geometry and electrical properties alter sheath, ion energy/angular distributions, and wafer-edge flux; no numerical coefficient imported
experimental focus-ring height changes wafer-edge sheath curvature and etch profile; no numerical coefficient imported
